description: This PHP class 'Rule' defines a validation rule with properties for rule class name, constructor parameters, and an optional message. It includes getter and setter methods for each property, encapsulating validation rule data within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: Rule
classes.description: A class representing a validation rule in the OrangeHRM API with properties for rule class, constructor parameters, and an optional message.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor to initialize the Rule object with class name, constructor parameters, and message.

methods.name: getRuleClass
methods.description: Returns the class name of the validation rule.

methods.name: setRuleClass
methods.description: Sets the class name of the validation rule.

methods.name: getRuleConstructorParams
methods.description: Retrieves the constructor parameters for the rule.

methods.name: setRuleConstructorParams
methods.description: Sets the constructor parameters for the rule.

methods.name: getMessage
methods.description: Gets the validation message associated with the rule.

methods.name: setMessage
methods.description: Sets the validation message for the rule.
